dct_title_s: Asia : China _ Yellow Sea. Terminal Head to Haiyung Tao including Elliot and Blonde Groups
dct_description_sm: From British and Japanese surveys to 1906.
Depths shown by soundings and tints; relief by contours and spot heights.
Shows low water areas, drainage, islands, wetland, roads, buildings.
[Inset chart] : Blonde Group : Changtze Tao Anchorage
